pr_body:
What has been changed?

* Modify the support models of MiniCPMV. As the official `MiniCPM-V-2` repo  still doesn't support `vllm`. I create a repo of my own for temporarily using. I claim this in the doc for eliminating the confusions of this.
* Using `*Model` for LLM part instead of `*CausalModel`. And delete the previously added code in `*CausalModel`. This make our code consistent with other VLMs.
* Automatically infer version when it is not specified in the config. (fixes #6814)
